queries.name: schedules
queries.sql: SELECT id, platform, weekday, start_time, duration_minutes, lead_minutes, trail_minutes, reason, enabled, effective_from, effective_until, deleted_at IS NOT NULL AS deleted FROM platform_maintenance_schedules ORDER BY id

queries.name: activity_log
queries.sql: SELECT log_name, description, subject_type, event, subject_id, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.platform') AS platform, JSON_VALUE(properties, '$.attributes.enabled') AS enabled FROM activity_log ORDER BY id
